messages:
sam: FYI seeing customers hit unexpected extra tokens when mobile clients reconnect mid-stream. Rapid thread:
mica: repro?
sam: 1) start streaming chat, 2) simulate flaky mobile network, 3) SDK reconnects without session_id, 4) router/ratecheck treats as new request so prefix tokens get charged again. Sample log: `charge_event: route=us-west tokens=+48 trace=abc123` followed by another `+48` on resume.
jordy: Is this happening only with the new ratecheck canary?
sam: Mostly yes, but we saw a few hits on prod routes not in canary due to config drift.
kat: Can we detect dupes reliably? What identifiers are available on reconnect?
sam: mobile SDKs often send `connect_id` but not `session_id`. We have `prefix_hash` + client_ip + user_id in traces.
mica: Two-prong plan: short term - surface provisional charges in Console and expose per-stream charge breakdown; long term - runtime dedupe on resume using session metadata or prefix hash.
jordy: Runtime approach: when a resume appears, check session store for last_confirmed_offset and billed_prefix_hash. If match, skip recharging. Pseudocode: 
```
// on resume request
if (hdr.session_id) {
  s = sessions.get(hdr.session_id)
  if (s && s.billed_prefix_hash == hdr.prefix_hash) {
    serve_without_charge()
    return
  }
}
mark_provisional_and_trace()
```
kat: That adds a read to hot path. Could we piggyback on heartbeat/lease RPC?
jordy: Yes - read is O(1) from local shard if routed by session affinity. For missing session_id we fallback to provisional.
sam: Console UX: add columns `provisional_tokens` and `confirmed_tokens` on per-session/route view, filter by `reconnect=true`. Also provide quick action to escalate refund to Billing.
mica: Telemetry: emit `reconnect_provisional_incidents`, `duplicate_resume_charge_rate`, and a histogram of `time_between_prefixes`.
kat: Toolcalls: special case. If we billed toolcall cost before reconnect, the resumed stream should not rebill toolcall. Persist `toolcall_id` in session meta and consult it on resume.
sam: Agreed. If resume arrives mid-toolcall and `toolcall_id` already marked billed, only bill suffix tokens.
jordy: For SDKs without session_id we can roll out heuristic: require `connect_id` + prefix_hash match within 10s to dedupe; flag orgs that opt-in.
mica: Also create a console flag to view only provisional charges so CS can triage refunds fast.
sam: Automations: create a rule that auto-creates a provisional refund ticket when we detect same prefix_hash and same user within 5s and duplicate charge pattern. billing-bot, create that?
billing-bot: Created rule billing:auto_prov_refund_dupes (threshold=2 matches within 10s).
kat: Deploy plan: 1) small telemetry UI patch (this week), 2) resume-dedupe POC behind feature flag (next sprint), 3) canary at 5% routes, expand to 50% if no regression.
jordy: Tests to add: router unit tests for resume when session missing, integration test simulating reconnects with/without session_id, billing reconciliation job to detect past dupes.
mica: Add migration note for older SDKs: log connect_id on reconnect, and start emitting `prefix_hash` from client to improve dedupe accuracy in next SDK release.
sam: I'll open an ENG ticket with sample traces and CS examples. Also will add example queries for billing team to find affected customers.
kat: One more: ensure rate-limiter doesn't double-count provisional tokens into quotas until confirmed. Otherwise customers might see quota exhaustion.
jordy: Good catch. Quota counters should be incremented only on confirmed charges; provisional increments tracked separately and reconciled.
mica: I'll own Console changes and telemetry. jordy owns router POC. sam will coordinate billing reconciliation. kat will review runtime perf.
sam: Thanks all :thumbsup:
